title: 非谓语作定语
explanation:
## 三种非谓语作定语

doing、done、to do 都能放在名词后作定语,选择哪种取决于**主动/被动**与**时间**两个维度。

## 现在分词 doing(主动、进行)

表示"正在进行的主动动作",如 the boy playing basketball(正在打篮球的男孩)。单个分词也可放名词前:a developing country(发展中国家)。

## 过去分词 done(被动、完成)

表示"被动的或已完成的动作",如 the letter written in English(用英语写的信)、a developed country(发达国家)。注意区分:the falling leaves(正在飘落的叶子)vs the fallen leaves(已经落下的叶子)。

## 不定式 to do(将来、目的)

表示"将要发生的动作"或"该做的事",常与 the first/last/only、序数词、被修饰词的搭配词连用:the first person to arrive(第一个到的人)、something to drink(可以喝的东西)。

## 与定语从句的转换

doing 定语 = that/which + 主动进行;done 定语 = that/which + 被动;to do 定语 = that/which will。写作中学会三者互换,可有效避免句式重复。

examples.en: The girl singing on the stage is my sister.
examples.cn: 在台上唱歌的女孩是我妹妹。
examples.note: singing 表主动、正在进行,相当于 who is singing。

examples.en: The bridge built last year is very modern.
examples.cn: 去年建的那座桥非常现代化。
examples.note: built 表被动、完成,相当于 which was built。

examples.en: He is the last student to leave the classroom.
examples.cn: 他是最后一个离开教室的学生。
examples.note: the last + to do,表示"最后一个做某事的人"。

examples.en: There are many problems to solve.
examples.note: to do 作定语表将来,隐含"将要/需要"之意。

errors.wrong: The window breaking last night has been repaired.
errors.right: The window broken last night has been repaired.
errors.note: 窗户是"被打破"的,要用过去分词 broken,不是主动的 breaking。

errors.wrong: The man spoke to the teacher is our principal.
errors.right: The man speaking to the teacher is our principal.
errors.note: 主动进行用 speaking,不能用动词原形 spoke。

errors.wrong: A developed country is one that is still growing.
errors.right: A developing country is one that is still growing.
errors.note: 还在发展用 developing(进行),developed 表示已发达。

quiz.q: The book ___ on the desk belongs to Tom.
quiz.note: lying 表主动进行,"躺/平放"的不及物用法。

quiz.q: The problems ___ at the meeting will be solved next week.
quiz.note: problems 被讨论,用过去分词 discussed。

quiz.q: She was the first woman ___ the mountain.
quiz.note: the first 后接 to do 作定语。

quiz.q: The students ___ from Class 3 won the game.
quiz.note: 主动进行,coming 相当于 who came。

quiz.q: I have nothing ___ about the plan.
quiz.note: nothing + to do,不定式作定语表将来。
